meta.name: layer-2s
meta.description: Ethereum L2 landscape — Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, zkSync, Unichain, Celo. How they work, how to deploy, how to bridge, and which to use when. Includes 2025–2026 updates like Celo migration and Polygon zkEVM shutdown.

copy.tagline: 摸清以太坊二层方案,搞定部署与跨链
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在以太坊上做开发,想弄懂L2怎么选怎么用
copy.tagline_en: Understand Ethereum L2s, deploy apps, and bridge assets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build on Ethereum and want to master L2s.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能讲解以太坊二层网络（L2）的格局，涵盖 Arbitrum、Optimism、Base 等方案，说明它们如何运作、如何部署、如何桥接，并按场景给出选型建议；也会提到 Celo 迁移、Polygon zkEVM 关闭等 2025-2026 动态。
howto.when: 当用户询问以太坊 L2（如 Arbitrum、Optimism、Base 等）的运作、部署或桥接，或提到 Celo 迁移、Polygon zkEVM 关闭等 2025-2026 动态时。

say.text: Arbitrum 和 Optimism 的工作原理有什么区别？
say.note: Claude 会对比这两条 L2 的机制差异。

say.text: 怎么把资产从以太坊主网桥接到 Base？
say.note: Claude 会给出桥接步骤与注意事项。

say.text: 2025 年做 DeFi 项目，选哪个 L2 部署？
say.note: Claude 会按场景给出选型建议。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to explain the Ethereum L2 landscape — Arbitrum, Optimism, Base and more — covering how they work, deploy, bridge, and which to choose. Also covers 2025–2026 updates like the Celo migration and Polygon zkEVM shutdown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about Ethereum L2s such as Arbitrum, Optimism or Base — how they work, deploy or bridge — or mentions 2025–2026 updates like the Celo migration.

say_en.text: What's the difference between how Arbitrum and Optimism work?
say_en.note: Claude will compare the mechanisms of these two L2s.

say_en.text: How do I bridge assets from Ethereum mainnet to Base?
say_en.note: Claude will give bridging steps and things to watch for.

say_en.text: Which L2 should I deploy on for a DeFi project in 2025?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest options based on your use case.
